metadata.article_title: Adjudication of claim to property attached before judgment.

article.title: Adjudication of claim to property attached before judgment.
article.content: Where any claim is preferred to property attached before judgment, such claim shall be adjudicated upon in the manner hereinbefore provided for the adjudication of claim to property attached in execution of a decree for the payment of money.]
article.html:
8Adjudication of claim to property attached before judgment.

Order 38, Rule 8

Where any claim is preferred to property attached before judgment, such claim shall be adjudicated upon in the manner hereinbefore provided for the adjudication of claim to property attached in execution of a decree for the payment of money.]

2 Subs. by s. 85, ibid., for rule 8 (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
